Takes the next connection that a client made to a TCP server and returns a stream for it. If nobody connected within the accept timeout of [TCPTimeouts](TCPTimeouts), which is 0 until you set it, it returns 0, so call it in a loop.

```blitzbasic
;run
TCPTimeouts 1000, 1000
server = CreateTCPServer(40751)
client = OpenTCPStream("127.0.0.1", 40751)
connection = 0
For i = 1 To 50
	connection = AcceptTCPStream(server)
	If connection <> 0 Then Exit
	Delay 20
Next
WriteLine client, "hello server"
Print ReadLine$(connection)
CloseTCPStream client
CloseTCPStream connection
CloseTCPServer server
```

```text
hello server
```
@param tcp_server  The server from [CreateTCPServer](CreateTCPServer).
@returns A TCP stream, or 0 when nobody connected.
